description: Models for the Card Match (memory) game, including data classes for cards and game state management.

classes.name: CardMatchCard
classes.description: Represents a card in the memory game, with properties for ID, value, and face/match status.

classes.name: CardMatchState
classes.description: Holds the persistent state of a game session, including card values, face-up/matched status arrays, move count, matched pairs, and selected card indices.

methods.name: cardCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of cards in the game based on the values array.
